articles.summary: Jacobs plans to release its fiscal third quarter 2026 earnings results after market close on Tuesday, Aug. 4, 2026, and will host a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET, during which management will make a presentation focusing on the company’s results and operating trends.
articles.title: Jacobs to hold its fiscal third quarter 2026 earnings conference call and webcast

articles.summary: Jacobs has been selected as one of several service providers under a multidisciplinary framework agreement with TransnetBW, one of Germany’s four transmission system operators, to support grid expansion programs critical to modernizing the country’s energy network and enabling increased integration of renewable energy.
articles.title: Jacobs secures multidisciplinary framework to advance Germany’s grid expansion

articles.summary: The Torrens to Darlington (T2D) Project has reached a key milestone with the commissioning of its first tunnel boring machine (TBM), marking a significant milestone in delivering a non-stop South Road.
articles.title: South Australia’s largest infrastructure project reaches critical milestone

articles.summary: Jacobs has been selected by the Los Angeles County Metropolitan Transportation Authority, working with Clark Construction Group, to design and build advanced charging infrastructure at two of LA Metro’s Bus Divisions in the cities of Carson and West Hollywood.
articles.title: Jacobs to support clean transit expansion in Los Angeles ahead of 2028

articles.summary: Jacobs has been selected by Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command Washington to deliver architectural and engineering services for military installations under an indefinite delivery/indefinite quantity single-award task order contract.
articles.title: Jacobs to deliver engineering design for military installations across the US national capital region

articles.summary: Jacobs is expanding its significant role in modernizing the U.K.'s infrastructure, securing three new commissions with National Highways.
articles.title: Jacobs secures three strategic UK National Highways contracts

articles.summary: PA Consulting, a Jacobs company, has launched its Brand Impact Index 2026, in which 7,000 U.S. consumers ranked leading consumer packaged goods and electronics brands according to consumer perceptions of how well they deliver dependable experiences, intelligent innovation, customer-centricity, sustainability and community impact.
articles.title: Widening gap between brand priorities and consumer experiences, according to PA Consulting’s Brand Impact Index

articles.summary: Jacobs was selected by Tilt Renewables, a leading wind developer and operator, as Owner’s Engineer for its 288-megawatt Palmer Wind Farm near Adelaide, South Australia.
articles.title: Jacobs secures owner’s engineer role for wind farm project in South Australia

articles.summary: Earlier named No. 1 overall design firm, Jacobs now leads in 17 total market categories, including data centers, semiconductors, pharmaceuticals, airports and more, bringing its total to 18 No. 1 rankings across ENR’s full 2026 market review. The results reflect Jacobs’ central position in today’s major infrastructure and advanced manufacturing growth trends.
articles.title: Jacobs earns 18 No.1 rankings across Engineering News-Record’s full 2026 market review

articles.summary: Jacobs has been selected by Great British Energy – Nuclear to provide planning and consenting services for the proposed small modular reactors development in the U.K.
articles.title: Jacobs appointed by Great British Energy – Nuclear to support planning for new UK nuclear projects

articles.summary: The Board of Directors of Jacobs has declared a quarterly cash dividend payable to shareholders in the amount of $0.36 per share of Jacobs common stock.
articles.title: Jacobs declares quarterly dividend
